title: Swear to a clan, hold the standards
changes: Every war zone has clan standards on banner poles. Press E at one to swear to a clan (from level 5; you can change once a day).
Stand in a standard's ring: on your clan's land you defend it, next to it you attack. Every minute counts when the fronts move.
The front plaque tells you whether you are defending, attacking, or your clan cannot reach that land yet.
